system.description:
In moments of desperate need, call upon the might of your deity. Choose any Divine spell that costs 3 ember or less, and cast it for 1 ember instead.
If your despair is greater still, you may demand the impossible. Make any request and test Sanity:
The Dark Master determines the DR based on the severity of your request, and may outright refuse it.
Note: a demand is never easier than DR16. As a guide: DR16 for a small mercy (a locked door gives way, a fever breaks, a lamp relights in the dark); DR18 for a great one (a storm turns, a foe is struck down, a collapsing tunnel holds); DR20 for a miracle that bends the world (the dead draw breath, the Gloaming recedes from a street for a night). Anything greater, the gods simply do not answer.

outcomes.ruin: Your deity smites you for your insolence. You are at Death's Door.

outcomeEffects.note: cast a Divine spell of 3 ember or less for 1 ember, or demand the impossible at the DR the Dark Master sets (never below DR16)
